records.description: Earlier this afternoon, one of our customers called saying they received an email from our shared support mailbox with another client's invoice attached. I checked the sent items and it looks like the wrong file may have been included, but I am not completely sure whether the recipient opened it or forwarded it. The invoice seems to include customer name, billing details, and account information. My supervisor is aware, but as far as I know IT or security has not been notified yet. The message was sent through Outlook from the support mailbox while I was working remotely from home. I do not think this is still happening, but I cannot fully confirm because other team members also use the same mailbox. I have not changed anything except checking the sent folder and telling my supervisor. This may affect the customer who received it and the client whose invoice was attached, but I do not know if anyone else is impacted. I can still work normally, though I am worried we may need to recall the email or contact the customer.
